title: Ephemeral UI card (draft v0)
description: A card is data the host renders. The host owns theme, layout and permission prompts; the card never runs code.

app.description: Catalog id, e.g. gmail, github, uber. Trace kinds use omp-stats.

ttl.description: How long the card lives: 'until-done' (default), 'pinned', or milliseconds.

actions.description: Writes are only allowed through a confirmation the host draws (hold, tap). Trace kinds never write.

input.description: Trace kinds: the omp-stats endpoint the card was fed from (path + query), or the payload itself. $defs.traceInput lists the shape each kind takes.

layers.description: Trace kinds: which data layers are drawn. Toggling a layer re-renders the card; it never refetches.

layer.description: spans: span blocks and lanes. tokens: model spans scaled by tokens, token columns. cost: cost cells and per-track cumulative cost lanes. errors: failed spans in red, error columns. subagents: child tracks and per-track rows. transcript: ordered span list under the timeline (message text is never shown on the public site).

traceInput.description: What each trace kind takes. Shapes are omp-stats' own (packages/stats/src/shared-types.ts): an agent fetches the endpoint and passes the JSON straight in.

trace.description: SessionTrace from /api/session/trace?file=<session>. Drawer usage (input/output/cached, provider, stop reason) from /api/session/entry?file=<track.file>&id=<span.entryId>.

trace-span.description: { span: TraceSpan, track: TraceTrack } from a SessionTrace, plus the span's /api/session/entry.

trace-summary.description: SessionTrace (summary for the strip, tracks for per-track cost and model time).

trace-tools.description: ToolDashboardStats from /api/stats/tools?range=<r>; SessionTrace[] adds p50/p95 and click-through spans.

trace-errors.description: MessageStats[] from /api/stats/errors?range=<r>&limit=<n>; SessionTrace[] adds span failures with jump-to-span.

statsComponent.description: Stats library component (src/js/stats-lib.js, stats-trace.js, stats-routes.js): make(data, opts) returns { el, spec, getSelection(), on(type, cb) → off }. data is the omp-stats API JSON for that component, unchanged. This object describes c.spec.

kind.description: Stat, StatGrid, Sparkline, ShareBar, BarList, Legend, Chart, TimeChart, Segmented, RangeControl, SearchInput, Table, Drawer, Modal, JsonBlock, Badge, LiveChip, RequestDrawer, TimelineCanvas, Minimap, SpanDrawer, SummaryStrip, AggregatesPanel, TranscriptList, TraceView, OverviewView, ModelsView, ProvidersView, CostsView, RequestsView, ErrorsView, TracesView, ToolsView, FrustrationView, ProjectsView, GainView, StatsDashboard (tables may name themselves, e.g. RequestLog).

statsComponent.$comment: opts: range, now, layers, highlight {model, provider, tool, folder, request, span}, density, request(id), trace(file), entry(file, id), windows(provider). Events: see statsEvent.

statsEvent.description: What a stats component emits (c.on and the bubbling DOM 'stats:event'). Ids only, never DOM or raw text.

part.description: Child that produced it, e.g. timeline, minimap, drawer, totals.

label.description: One readable line for the agent.

publicFixtureExtensions.description: Fields the sanitized public fixture adds on top of the omp-stats shapes. A live host may omit them.

TraceSpan.resultChars.description: Length of the tool output that was withheld.

TraceSpan.errorKind.description: Error kind (timeout, non-zero exit, not found, …) in place of the error text.
